subject: Rapid throughput safety lane + pricing bridge for BrightFi launch
messages:
From: Sophie Liang <sophie.liang@brightfi.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: BrightFi Engineering <eng+redwood@brightfi.com>
Date: 2028-07-01T08:12:00Z
Subject: Quick ask: short runway of extra throughput for launch day

Jonas —

Hope you’re well. We have a high-impact marketing-driven launch scheduled for Friday (07/05) and our forecasted inference volume for a 3-hour peak window is ~4x what’s in our current committed tier. We can’t absorb a long procurement cycle right now — is there any way Redwood can open a short, time-bound "safety lane" (temporary throughput elevation) for that window?

Key constraints:
- Needs to be active 07/05 15:00–18:00 PT.
- We expect ~150M tokens during the window (short responses).
- We need a pricing note or estimate immediately for procurement.

We’re open to an interim fee (metered or flat) and will follow up with PO. If this requires approval, please loop in whoever you need — we need a yes/no by EOD today.

Attached: launch-day spike summary (short).

Thanks — appreciate the quick turn, Sophie
Sophie Liang
Head of Platform Ops | BrightFi
+1 415-555-0192

Attachment: brightfi_launch_sprint_requirements.pdf (1.2MB PDF, summary slide)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-01T09:05:00Z
Subject: Fwd: Quick ask: short runway of extra throughput for launch day

Marissa / Ben —

Forwarding Sophie’s note — BrightFi needs a 3-hour bounded uplift next Friday for a public launch. They don’t want a full contract amendment; they’d accept an interim arrangement (metered or flat) and will send PO. Can we do a short-term safety lane that:

Options I’m thinking:
1) Elastic runway: open +3x token headroom for a 3-hour window, charge pay-as-you-go at 1.6x hosted per-token rate, and apply a 30% credit against next month’s invoice if they convert to a committed tier within 30 days.
2) Flat burst block: sell a fixed bucket (150M tokens) at a discounted block price (easier for procurement), no rollover.
3) Fallback policy: if peak exceeds bucket, auto-failover to lower-cost variant with throttling and immediate notification.

Can you confirm which is simplest to approve today and draft a short note I can send to Sophie? Also flag any SLA or capacity risk.

Thanks,
Jonas
VP, Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-01T11:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Fwd: Quick ask: short runway of extra throughput for launch day

Jonas / Ben —

Thanks for flagging. Quick operational note: we have capacity headroom in our US pool that day but it’s allocated conservatively. I discussed with infra — we can commit a bounded surge lane for a 3-hour window with explicit routing and a hard cap. Proposed commercial terms (fast-approve version):

- Term: One-time 3-hour safety lane on 2028-07-05 15:00–18:00 PT.
- Capacity: up to 200M tokens (covers their 150M forecast w/ buffer).
- Price: $0.028 per 1k tokens (hosted retail baseline is $0.018/1k; this is a short-lived uplift premium).
- Billing: Pay-as-you-go; invoice net 30. If customer converts to a 3‑month committed tier covering >= 50% of the uplift within 30 days, apply a $5k credit.
- Failover: If utilization exceeds 200M tokens, requests will be throttled and routed to a lower-cost model variant; we’ll notify via webhook and email.

We can supply a one-page addendum for procurement (simple language, signature line). I’ve attached the short sprint pricing table and a sample addendum language. If Ben OKs, we can send to Sophie with the pricing and an attached addendum and PO instructions.

Marissa
Sr. Director, Commercial Deals | Redwood Inference

Attachment: brightfi_sprint_pricing_table.xlsx (stub)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-01T13:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Fwd: Quick ask: short runway of extra throughput for launch day

All —

Thumbs up on Marissa’s wording. A couple quick additions from a billing/legal standpoint:
- Add a single-sentence cap on liability for the 3-hour lane (standard limited liability clause).
- Require PO to be sent by 07/03 EOD to lock the lane. If PO arrives later, we’ll still try to enable but with no guaranteed capacity.

If agreed, I’ll approve the one-pager. Recommend we offer both options (metered per-token and fixed-block) in the same addendum so procurement can choose. That tends to speed things up.

Ben
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Liang <sophie.liang@brightfi.com>, Procurement <procurement@brightfi.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-02T10:18:00Z
Subject: Re: Quick ask: short runway of extra throughput for launch day

Sophie —

Great to hear from you and congrats on the launch. We can run the bounded safety lane on 2028-07-05 15:00–18:00 PT. Below is the short-form commercial proposal and next steps so procurement has everything they need.

Short-form proposal (choose one):
A) Metered safety lane
- Up to 200M tokens during the 3-hour window.
- Price: $0.028 / 1k tokens.
- Billing: Pay-as-you-go; net 30.
- Credit: $5,000 credit if convert to >=3-month commit covering >=50% of uplift within 30 days.

B) Fixed burst block
- One-time bucket of 150M tokens assigned to BrightFi for the window.
- Price: $3,800 flat (prepaid).
- No rollover.

Other terms
- PO deadline to guarantee lane: 2028-07-03 EOD.
- Overrun: if actual usage > allocated tokens under (A) or (B), we’ll throttle and route to fallback model; overrun charges are billed at $0.045 / 1k tokens.
- Liability: Redwood’s liability limited to fees paid under this addendum.

Attachments: 1) one-page safety-lane addendum (simple signature line), 2) sample invoice workflow.

If you want me to sign the addendum on behalf of Redwood, I can do so once procurement confirms the PO.

Thanks — we’ll standby for the PO.

—Jonas
VP, Partnerships | Redwood Inference

Attachments: safety-lane-addendum.docx (1 page), sprint-pricing-table.xlsx

From: Sophie Liang <sophie.liang@brightfi.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Procurement <procurement@brightfi.com>
Cc: BrightFi Engineering <eng+redwood@brightfi.com>
Date: 2028-07-03T15:04:00Z
Subject: Re: Quick ask: short runway of extra throughput for launch day

Jonas / team —

Thanks — we’ll take option B (fixed burst block) to keep procurement happy and get this over the finish line. PO attached and procurement confirms the 07/03 EOD deadline is met. Please confirm you’ve reserved the block and send the addendum for signature.

Cheers,
Sophie

Attachment: brightfi_po_0759.pdf (PO for $3,800)
